name: Fiserv USD
oneLiner: FIUSD is a pre-launch fully-reserved dollar stablecoin from Fiserv, built on Solana with Circle and Paxos infrastructure for interbank payments at FI clients.
collateral: Fully reserved USD backing for FIUSD, with Fiserv expecting to use Paxos and Circle stablecoin infrastructure
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed 1:1 dollar redemption model; Fiserv describes FIUSD as a fully reserved USD-backed stablecoin that is always redeemable at $1 USD
launchPhaseDetail: Platform live; Q1 2026 earnings (May 5): CEO Lyons confirms stablecoin pilot for interbank money movement; Huntington confirmed as pilot partner alongside Bank of North Dakota and others (cross-border, digital escrow); INDX cash settlement launched Feb 2026; StoneCastle acquired; May 14 Investor Day positioned FIUSD as a core strategic growth vector ('issued through banks, accepted through merchants'). At the Bernstein Strategic Decisions conference (June 3 2026) CEO Lyons confirmed 'FIUSD goes live in July,' setting July 2026 for the interbank platform launch. That window closed without a launch announcement. The Q2 2026 earnings release filed with the SEC on August 6 2026 does not mention FIUSD, stablecoins, digital assets, or Solana anywhere, and Fiserv cut its full-year guidance in the same release. Pharos retired the July expectation on September 6 2026 and now carries the year only. Bank of North Dakota's Roughrider Coin white-label is still expected to begin its state-bank pilot in September 2026, on a platform with no confirmed go-live

featuredContent.title: Fiserv Joins Stablecoin Fray, Teaming Up With Circle and Paxos
featuredContent.description: Fiserv enters the stablecoin space with FIUSD, a bank-friendly coin built on Solana targeting its network of 10,000 financial institutions and 6 million merchant locations.

milestones.title: Fiserv announces FIUSD stablecoin on Solana
milestones.description: FIUSD built for 10,000 financial institution clients and 6 million merchant locations, leveraging Paxos and Circle infrastructure.

milestones.title: Mastercard partnership to integrate FIUSD across 150M+ merchants
StoneCastle acquisition announced to help FIs retain funds from FIUSD issuance
Fiserv powers Roughrider Coin for Bank of North Dakota
INDX real-time cash settlement platform launched for digital asset firms
milestones.description: Up to $25M FDIC insurance, distributes across 1,100+ insured financial institutions.

milestones.title: Q1 earnings: CEO confirms stablecoin pilot on track for summer 2026
milestones.description: CEO Michael Lyons: 'on track to launch our previously announced stablecoin pilot this summer to facilitate interbank money movement.' Huntington confirmed as pilot partner alongside Bank of North Dakota and several other banks.

milestones.title: FIUSD featured at Fiserv 2026 Investor Day as a strategic growth vector
milestones.description: Fiserv positions FIUSD on an 'issued through banks, accepted through merchants' model with real-time clearing/settlement and white-label issuance; interbank-money-movement pilots with Bank of North Dakota, Huntington, and others remain on track for summer 2026.

milestones.title: CEO Lyons confirms FIUSD goes live in July 2026 at Bernstein conference
milestones.description: At the Bernstein Strategic Decisions conference, CEO Michael Lyons stated 'FIUSD goes live in July,' setting July 2026 for the interbank platform launch.

milestones.title: July go-live window closes; Q2 2026 results do not mention FIUSD
milestones.description: The Q2 2026 earnings release Fiserv filed with the SEC contains no reference to FIUSD, stablecoins, digital assets, or Solana, and the company cut full-year guidance. No launch announcement followed the July window CEO Lyons had set in June.
